subject: Discovery recap: migration off proprietary LLM APIs -> open models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: migration off proprietary LLM APIs -> open models

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap from our conversation and the ask items we agreed on: 

Pain points you highlighted
- Cost & vendor lock-in with your current OpenAI/Anthropic spend (embeddings + chat completions).
- Rate limits and burstability concerns during peak trading hours.
- Need for function-calling / structured outputs (webhook-style) compatibility.
- Data residency and audit log requirements for EU customers.

Current stack you told us about
- Frontend: web + mobile clients calling a backend that proxies to OpenAI & Anthropic.
- Embeddings pipeline: OpenAI embeddings for semantic search + similarity scoring.
- Chat: few-shot prompts with function calling for account ops workflows.
- Traffic: ~500M tokens/day currently, spikes ~2x during end-of-month settlement windows.

Success criteria for a migration POC
- Parity with current function-calling behavior and structured outputs.
- Embedding quality within 5% of current similarity scores on your benchmark dataset.
- Latency target: median <150ms for chat response tokens.
- Cost target: meaningful per-token savings vs current spend or clear path via quantization/batching.
- Security: EU data residency option + SOC2 evidence.

Model compatibility & shortlist (initial)
- Llama-2-chat (quantized variants)
- Mistral Large / Mistral-Instruct family
- Falcon-40B (or quantized equivalent)
- MPT-30B (embedding-capable variants)

Redwood fit / immediate asks from your side
- We can provide an OpenAI-compatible shim and function-calling surface to minimize app changes.
- For the POC, please share a representative prompt set + 200 labeled queries for embedding evals, and sample traffic profile (tokens/day, typical sequence length).
- We’ll follow up with a mutual action plan and a proposed POC SOW (attached).

Next steps
1) Alex: share the 200 query sample + security questionnaire (you mentioned procurement would send).
2) Redwood: send mutual-action-plan + POC checklist (attached).
3) Schedule a kickoff with your infra/SRE + our infra (I’ll propose times).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-FT-2026-0423.pdf (PDF)

If I missed anything or you want to prioritize different success criteria, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off proprietary LLM APIs -> open models

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the thorough recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: we currently average ~500M tokens/day, peaks at ~1B tokens on heavy days. Typical request sequences are 256–1024 tokens.
- Embeddings: primary use is semantic search for customer support + risk signal matching. We use OpenAI embeddings but we are open to alternatives if quality holds.
- Function calling: critical for our account operations flows (e.g., close account, flag fraud). The contract requires us to preserve existing webhook behaviors.
- Compliance: EU residency is a must for EEA customers; SOC2 evidence required for vendor approval.

Procurement will send over the security questionnaire and an NDA redline (attached). We’re comfortable running a 4-week technical POC if the model parity looks good.

Can you also send an initial cost estimate for steady-state (post-POC) assuming 500M tokens/day and an option for quantized 8-bit deployment? That will help speed internal approvals.

Attached: security-questionnaire-FinTechCo.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll aim to get the questionnaire back by EOD Wed.

Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com | +1 (628) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off proprietary LLM APIs -> open models

Great — thanks Alex. Attaching a short mutual action plan and a POC checklist to make the 4-week run deterministic. Highlights on our side:

- Model shortlist refined for the POC: Llama-2-chat (latest chat weights), Mistral-Instruct, Falcon-40B-instruct, MPT-30B-chat. We’ll test quantized 8-bit/4-bit variants where quality permits.
- Redwood will provide an OpenAI-compatible API shim and function-calling emulation so your engineering changes are minimal.
- For embeddings we’ll run your 200-sample eval against embedding-capable variants and report similarity delta and retrieval metrics.
- Security: we’ll send our SOC2 cert and an EU region deployment option for the POC.

Action items we’ll take after receiving your questionnaire + sample queries:
- Load the sample traffic into a Canary instance, run embedding + chat parity tests, and provide a targeted latency/cost report.
- Propose a POC kickoff time (I’m suggesting Thu 2026-03-05 09:00 PT) — we’ll include our infra + a solutions engineer (Vivek).
- Provide a draft cost estimate for 500M tokens/day with an 8-bit quantized option.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-FT-2026-0423.pdf

Thanks — looping Vivek to coordinate the tech kickoff.

Best,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: migration off proprietary LLM APIs -> open models

Alex — quick tech note:

- Can you confirm the canonical embedding dimension you use and your typical index backfill window? Those will affect the choice of embedding model and indexing strategy.
- Also, do you use streaming token output for chat in any of the customer workflows (we’ll need to preserve streaming behavior for UX parity)?

If Thu 03/05 09:00 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda (POC goals, traffic profile, security handoffs, success metrics).

Cheers,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
